targets.name: Limine
targets.scope: Current pinned Stage 0 provider for the experimental x86_64 kernel.
targets.notes: Do not remove until DuckBoot has qualified fallback and recovery.

targets.name: GNU GRUB 2
targets.scope: Config discovery and later qualified install or chainload adapter.
targets.notes: Each operation remains disabled until its adapter and recovery tests pass.

targets.name: GRUB Legacy
targets.scope: Bounded read-only inspection and migration guidance.

targets.name: systemd-boot
targets.scope: ESP and XBOOTLDR entry discovery and supported selection operations.

targets.name: rEFInd
targets.scope: UEFI discovery and chainload integration while preserving upstream configuration.

targets.name: SYSLINUX
targets.scope: BIOS configuration and module-aware inspection.

targets.name: ISOLINUX
targets.scope: ISO and live-media boot-entry inspection.

targets.name: EXTLINUX
targets.scope: Filesystem boot configuration inspection where support is qualified.

targets.name: PXELINUX
targets.scope: PXE menu discovery; does not imply DHCP or TFTP server provisioning.

targets.name: iPXE
targets.scope: Explicit network boot chain with local trust policy.
targets.notes: Network boot is opt-in and disabled by default.

targets.name: UEFI EFI-stub
targets.scope: Direct firmware launch of a kernel with a qualified EFI entry point.

targets.name: Unified Kernel Image
targets.scope: Verify and select a single signed boot artifact; not a separate bootloader.
targets.notes: Signature verification and anti-rollback are required before trusted status.

targets.name: Windows Boot Manager
targets.scope: Discover and chainload external Windows-owned EFI entry; preserve its files.

targets.name: shim
targets.scope: Record trust-chain stage and chain into a compatible next-stage loader.
targets.notes: Not a standalone desktop boot menu.

targets.name: U-Boot
targets.scope: Separate board-specific embedded adapter; not a default x86 desktop dependency.

targets.name: Barebox
targets.scope: Separate embedded adapter with explicit board and firmware capability declaration.

targets.name: Petitboot
targets.scope: Discover and chainload where a supported platform supplies Petitboot.

targets.name: OpenCore
targets.scope: External chainload target with platform and ownership limitations.

targets.name: Clover
targets.scope: External chainload target; no assumption of Apple firmware support.

targets.name: LILO
targets.scope: Read-only legacy inspection and migration path.
targets.notes: Not a new default installation target.
